title: Start: the NEAT brief, deadline Friday 17:00
text: BRIEF.md in this folder was a stale copy of the lunarlander-98 brief, a project already finished (PPO 98.8% / 98.4%). The user confirmed the real brief is NEXT_PROJECT_BRIEF.md: NEAT from a clean start, a curriculum, a network sized by measurement, a fast C++ simulator for training, and boulder layout v3. Deadline Friday 2026-11-06 17:00, wrap-up from 16:27. Machine: i5-8250U, 4 cores / 8 threads, 7.6 GB, no usable GPU.

title: Boulder layout v3 in the frozen task
text: One approved change to the world: the boulder's bottom now stays at least 3.5 m above the pad (v2: 1.73 m, less than the lander's 1.8 m height). Same random stream as v2, so each seed keeps its boulder size and sideways position; only the height moved, into a 3.0 m band. Test: on 100,000 seeds of each of the 6 seed ranges, every clearance holds. The passability test (a planner that may read the true wind, used only as a test) comes next.
